import json,pathlib,sys
from importlib.metadata import distributions
from importlib.util import find_spec
from packaging.requirements import Requirement
from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name
import repropatch
assert repropatch.__version__ == "0.2.0.dev6"
assert pathlib.Path(repropatch.__file__).is_relative_to(sys.prefix)
assert "agents" not in sys.modules and "openai" not in sys.modules
import repropatch.agent_runtime, repropatch.models
assert "agents" not in sys.modules and "openai" not in sys.modules
from repropatch.models import prepare_sdk
prepare_sdk()
import agents, openai
for module in (agents,openai): assert pathlib.Path(module.__file__).is_relative_to(sys.prefix)
packages={canonicalize_name(dist.metadata["Name"]):dist.version for dist in distributions()}
for line in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.strip(): continue
    requirement=Requirement(line)
    if requirement.marker is None or requirement.marker.evaluate():
        assert packages[canonicalize_name(requirement.name)] in requirement.specifier, requirement.name
print(json.dumps({"repropatch_location":repropatch.__file__,"agents_location":agents.__file__,"openai_location":openai.__file__,"packages":packages,"dependencies_match_constraints":True,"lazy_import_verified":True},indent=2))
